findings.claim: Criterion 4 leaves the gate outcome undefined when runtime tool-execution evidence is unmeasured, lacks a negative non-execution oracle and denied_actions schema/missing-field rule, and does not bind receipt generation or candidate hashes to pass/fail assertions.
Criterion 2 mandates a before/after validator contract comparison without a pass/fail predicate and underspecifies the raw-record locking test and historical local_process regression check.

WP1233 exclusivity lacks an explicit block rule on active lock detection, omits acceptance evidence from Criteria 1-5 (contradicting D?i chi?u review r1), and leaves ref-freshness and base-drift re-approval undefined.

Criterion 5 embeds Mission #1172 r98 conditional cap activation and B4/PR2 lease/ledger governance inside WP1499 acceptance criteria without separating coordinator authority from WP1499 implementer authority, and Write set grants directory-wide access to ops/specs/wp1499-r1/.

Scope assumes the existing argv[0] normalizer already strips one of (.exe, .cmd, .bat, .ps1) while restricting launcher.py edits to the transport table only, and Criterion 1 omits negative fallback expectations, unsupported suffixes, and symlink test criteria.
Criterion 3 leaves the allowlisted read commands, exact-match enforcement mechanism, global-state non-mutation proof, and evidence redaction/storage boundaries underspecified.
Criterion 5 forbids using the candidate launcher only as 'sole evidence' (leaving a self-attestation loophole) and underspecifies Antigravity transport provenance and positive test evidence.
